One cue: a quiet drone under the alpha card, a build through six worlds, a breath for the build-in-Claude-Code beat, the climb to one final hit, a ringing tail under the end card.

trailer/alpha.prompt: Genre: modern hybrid cinematic game trailer music, orchestra with pulsing analog synths. BPM: 110. Key: E minor rising to E major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir singing words. A one-minute trailer cue for an open-world adventure made of many different worlds stitched together: a sunny toon island, painted grasslands with horse riders, a photoreal pine forest, dusk desert dunes, golden sky islands, a neon vertical city. Structure: opens with a low warm synth drone and a soft ticking pulse for a few seconds; then shimmering strings and a hopeful piano motif; at about 10 seconds driving low string ostinato and taiko drums enter and the energy builds steadily with a new colour every few bars; at about 40 seconds a sudden breath, everything drops to a clean arpeggiated synth pulse and a held string note; then a riser and the full orchestra returns with a big heroic brass theme, pounding percussion and cymbal swells climbing to a huge climax; ends on one final massive hit at about 56 seconds and a long ringing tail. Production: modern trailer mix, wide, powerful low end, big hall reverb, punchy drums, clear hits.
